changelog: CUDA cuBLAS Automatic Fallback: Auto-detects NVIDIA GPU CUDA 12/11 DLL compatibility via two-tier defense, safely falling back to CPU INT8 if libraries are missing.
In-App Auto-Updater Swap Fix: Replaced tasklist-find pipe with graceful sleep and 10x robocopy retries to prevent pipe deadlock.
Live Caption Transcription Monitor: Real-time progress %, timecode, ETA, speed, word count, GPU/CPU badge, live transcript preview, and safe Cancel.
Seamless Inline Caption Editing: Click directly on the on-video caption box with focus border, Enter/click-outside auto-save, Esc cancel, and Saved badge.
Long-Video Stability Fix: Eliminated 3-minute UI freeze when editing captions on 2+ hour videos (<1ms latency) plus O(log N) playhead caption lookup.
Precision Caption Box Geometry: 4-slider Width/Height/Pos X/Pos Y controls with 2D auto-fit font sizing matching the visual bounds guide 1:1.
